rows.law: A loop that dies must file WHY. A wrapper that swallows its own death makes the subsystem silently vanish; stay non-fatal for the daemon but leave a trace.
rows.claim: The cost enforcer wrapper converted bare except-pass into a traced non-fatal print (LOOP-DEATH GUARD, 2026-09-25, commit 5c5f0a61e, ghost.py line 1569).
rows.quote: print(f"[ghost] COST-ENFORCER LOOP DEATH GUARD: cost_enforcer_loop exited: {_ce}", flush=True)
rows.steal: Sweep every daemon entry wrapper in the estate for except Exception: pass and convert each to a traced non-fatal print; land the audit receipt in watch/inbox/gala_20260925/.
rows.falsifier: Force cost_enforcer_loop to raise inside the wrapper in a test run and observe no '[ghost] COST-ENFORCER LOOP DEATH GUARD' line on stdout, or grep -F 'except Exception:' followed by pass in the wrapper region of mag/ghost.py.

rows.law: Silent death of a memory-weaving loop loses history with no trace. Non-fatal, but visible: the vaccine against the except-pass disease is a trace, not a crash.
rows.claim: The bard subscriber wrapper emits a BARD LOOP DEATH GUARD print on unexpected death, so Chronicle weave loss is distinguishable from never-started (ghost.py line 1585).
rows.quote: print(f"[ghost] BARD LOOP DEATH GUARD: bard_subscriber_loop exited: {_be}", flush=True)
rows.steal: Apply the same trace-not-crash pattern to any event subscriber or chronicle loop in other surfaces (lab UI, watch daemon) this week.
rows.falsifier: grep -n -A2 'async def _bard_loop_wrapper' mag/ghost.py and find 'except Exception:' with a bare pass body, or trigger a bard_subscriber_loop exception and see no guard line printed.

rows.law: A loop that re-fires the same quest forever is a missing trail fact. Gate re-fire on the landing artifact: a signature whose diagnosis file exists is HANDLED, not re-armable, and the suppression is itself a trail fact.
rows.claim: Commit 5c5f0a61e added a diagnosis-file existence check before appending an FKB quest, ending a run where one sig spawned 504 times between Aug 8 and Sep 22 (ghost.py lines 1409-1419).
rows.quote: # sig spawned 504 times (Aug 8 -> Sep 22) because the trail
rows.steal: For any recurring escalation or quest loop in the fleet, write a completion marker at the landing site and gate the next fire on its absence; add the gate comment naming the historical spawn count.
rows.falsifier: Create memory/runs/ghost/autonomous_fixes/<sig>.md for a sig with count >= 5, rerun the SENSE pass, and observe a new auto-fkb quest still appended for that sig.

rows.law: Silence is not one disease. Taxonomize before fixing: aggregator guards are BY DESIGN, loop-death guards are the black-hole species (fixed), daemon cycle guards have stated intent and stay flagged.
rows.claim: The wave2 receipt filed a 3-class taxonomy over ghost.py's 70 except-pass sites (4,244 lines, 140 except-Exception, zero bare excepts) before the first dent; ghost.py loop-death guards were class 2.
rows.steal: Before pruning the next except-pass chunk, read the target file and file its own 3-class taxonomy (design silence vs death swallowing vs stated-intent cycle guards) as the fix spec.
rows.falsifier: Read mag/ghost.py's remaining except-pass sites and find a swallowed wrapper death that the receipt claims is fixed, or find the taxonomy miscounts the site total (70).
